WITH 
user_day AS (
 SELECT t.date,t.user_id,u.device_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.amount_idr) gmv
 FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON u.user_id=t.user_id
 WHERE t.date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY t.date,t.user_id,u.device_id
), device_day AS (
 SELECT date,device_id,COUNT(*) payers FROM user_day GROUP BY date,device_id
), risk AS (
 SELECT p.date,p.user_id FROM user_day p JOIN device_day d
 ON p.date=d.date AND p.device_id=d.device_id
 WHERE p.n>=5 AND p.gmv>=2000000 AND d.payers>=3
)

        SELECT CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'risk_review'
          WHEN p.gmv>=200000 THEN 'high_value' ELSE 'regular_payer' END segment,
          COUNT(*) paying_uv,SUM(p.gmv) gross_gmv_idr
        FROM user_day p LEFT JOIN risk r ON p.date=r.date AND p.user_id=r.user_id GROUP BY segment

SELECT s.tier,COUNT(DISTINCT t.streamer_id) paying_streamers,
        SUM(t.amount_idr) gross_gmv_idr FROM transactions t JOIN streamers s ON t.streamer_id=s.streamer_id
        WHERE t.date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY s.tier
